title: Chairmate Chess
body: Use /chess challenge only in ♟️-chairmate. Choose a member and supported time control. The named member has five minutes to accept or decline. Lichess guest links stay private: each player uses Open My Game on the card.

fields.member: Only the nominated member may accept or decline.
fields.time: Choose a listed bullet, blitz, or rapid control.
fields.private_link: Never share the private game link; it grants access to that color.

steps: Pick your opponent and time control.
The opponent accepts the public card.
Each player selects Open My Game for their private Lichess board.
Return to the card for the posted result and replay.
